evidence.title: Code review — plan_validate.go core logic
evidence.description: Verified: 13 canonical sections defined with fuzzy keyword matching. normalizeHeader() strips leading numbers/punctuation, lowercases, collapses whitespace. extractH2Headers() only matches '## ' prefix (h3+ excluded). ValidatePlanCompleteness skips research kind early. Critical warnings (prompt-manager, greenfield) block Passed; non-critical (restart) do not. Idea-specific checks for scenario-generation and UI present. FormatGapReport produces structured markdown checklist format. WriteValidationReport/LoadValidationReport handle JSON serialization. LoadOrRefreshValidationReport compares mtime for staleness.
